The '''Awards Auditorium''' of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served as a place for the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] to present awards to various personnel from the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] various branches for tremendous service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from its construction circa [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] until the death of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==History==
{{Quote|We are here to honor one who has served the Empire.|Palpatine, presenting the Emperor's Will Award to Maarek Stele|<ref name="TIE" />}}
Located at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], the Emperor's Awards Auditorium was constructed following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. From a series of steps, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would address the attending personnel and personally hand over the necessary medal to Imperial personnel for specific acts of service to the Empire. One of these soldiers was the [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who was personally awarded the [[Emperor's Will (medal)/Legends|Emperor's Will]] medal by the Emperor himself via [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for his actions in [[Battle of Imperial Center|saving him]] from [[Treachery at Ottega|his abduction]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] over Coruscant during the latter's [[Zaarin insurrection|military coup]].<ref name="TIE" />

==Layout==
An enormous chamber designed for public matters, the Palace's Awards Auditorium consisted of a large auditorium, with a central walkway containing a red carpet adorned with the [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]]. On each side of the carpet are rows of soldiers standing at attention, and in front is a platform where the Emperor makes his pronouncements and supplies the award. The stage itself also was part of a towering building with six balconies (three on each side, with their having red and blue banners depicting the Imperial logo), with the center portion having the Imperial logo above as well as a central pillar. [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]] also guarded the area both at the top and at the bottom. The throne was likewise located at the stage behind the Emperor.
